madhu-padishala.name: Madhu Padishala
madhu-padishala.title: Founder, ClinixAI

gayathri-manager.name: Dr. Gayathri
gayathri-manager.title: Manager, Literature Sciences
gayathri-manager.bio: Dr. Gayathri leads literature screening and evidence review at ClinixAI, overseeing case-relevant literature surveillance across therapeutic areas.

wany-williams.name: Wany Williams
wany-williams.title: PV Associate, Literature Screening
wany-williams.bio: Wany works end-to-end across pharmacovigilance literature screening under Dr. Gayathri's supervision, from search strategy through case-relevant article triage.

dr-surya.name: Dr. Surya
dr-surya.title: Lead, PV Agreements & Signal Management
dr-surya.bio: Dr. Surya has 8+ years of pharmacovigilance experience focused on safety data exchange agreements, partner governance and signal management.

dr-harsha.name: Dr. Harsha
dr-harsha.title: Lead, Clinical Trial Safety & Regulatory Submissions
dr-harsha.bio: Dr. Harsha has 8+ years of pharmacovigilance experience spanning clinical trial safety, SUSAR/DSUR reporting and ICSR regulatory submissions.

divya-jagdish.name: Divya Jagdish
divya-jagdish.title: Operations Lead
divya-jagdish.bio: Divya moved into pharmacovigilance after 7+ years as a practicing pharmacist and has spent the last 5 years in PV operations, focused on quality systems, root cause analysis and CAPA closure.
